lessons_used: Choose path redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 9 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 10 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.

Finish hint, finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across tests, with predictions on finish hints often being too optimistic.
Kinds of change tested only once, such as adoption copy and adoption incentive, still have thin evidence.

candidates.title: Choose path mascot carousel layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting different pet creation journeys.
candidates.why: Choose path redesigns have won 2 of 3 past tests, and mean time on this screen is 514s, indicating some users hesitate when choosing a path.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose path screen layout into a carousel inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns have a strong track record (+3.7%, 2/3 wins), though evidence relies solely on drop-off time.

candidates.title: Pet voice and sound preview new screen in adoption
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet audio preview screen during adoption where users can test pet sound effects and voice clips.
candidates.why: Adoption has a steep conversion drop (72.4%). Giving users an interactive sound preview builds emotional attachment before committing.

new_pet_sound_preview.headline: Listen to Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_sound_preview.body: Preview how your pet speaks and reacts while living on your screen.

guard.reason: Adding a new sound preview screen within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but adding new screens has consistently performed poorly (-0.9% across 7 tests).

candidates.title: Compact single column account sign in redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact single-column card focusing on cloud pet backup protection.
candidates.why: Sign-in mean duration is high (567s) and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Link your account to keep your desktop companion safe and synchronized across devices.

guard.reason: Redesigning sign-in layout and copy inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Both support tickets and funnel metrics highlight this issue; sign-in redesigns show modest positive history (+0.8%).

candidates.title: Desktop pet interaction mode setup new flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive pet interaction mode selection component on the final intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to talk to or control their pet.

guard.reason: Adding desktop mode selection components to home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has the biggest drop-off (64.8%) and support reports match; new flow had +2.2% in 1 test but evidence is thin.

candidates.title: Photo upload clarity and retry guidance copy
candidates.change: Update body copy on the photo upload screen to provide explicit formatting and lighting recommendations.
candidates.why: Support mail highlighted 3 custom pet creation failures where generated pets looked wrong.

upload_photos.body: Upload a bright, front-facing photo with clear contrast so your custom 3D companion renders accurately.

candidates.title: Pick friend mascot carousel layout
candidates.change: Switch the pick friend companion selection screen layout to a carousel for browsing pet species.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest initial funnel drop (72.4%). Visual carousel browsing makes selecting a companion more engaging.

guard.reason: Changing the pick friend selection screen to a carousel layout is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops significantly and adoption layout changes have strong historical performance (+3.2%).

candidates.title: Reorder sign in after adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to occur right after completing the adoption certificate screen before pet rendering begins.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in after pet adoption commitment captures high user motivation right after adoption certificate completion.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in has minimal historical impact (+0.1%) with limited support evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop rendering tip display on waiting screen
candidates.change: Display helpful desktop interaction tips on the waiting screen while rendering takes place.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, while users frequently ask support how to control desktop pet features later.

waiting.hint: Desktop Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the screen to open quick controls or send your companion to sleep.

guard.reason: Adding rendering tips to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from time metrics and support, and low cost (config/text), but wait_info changes historically show little effect (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop pet quick start mastery badge on finish screen
candidates.change: Add a prominent companion readiness badge component on the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with total funnel completion at 34.0%; a visual completion badge encourages users to press finish.

guard.reason: Adding a readiness badge component to the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses many users, but finish step enhancements routinely perform poorly or show no clear effect.

candidates.title: Home intro story scroll layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a story scroll layout presenting key desktop pet shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish screen conversion is low (64.8%) and multiple support tickets complain about unclear desktop controls post-setup.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen into a story scroll layout is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with strong support backup, but past finish redesigns consistently reduced conversion (-3.0%).

lessons_next: Choose path redesign, sign in redesign, and home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 of 4, 3 of 10, and 2 of 10 tests respectively.
Finish hint, finish copy, finish new flow, and home wait info changes consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions on finish hint changes were consistently too high relative to measured results.
Choose path copy and adoption new screen changes frequently underperformed predictions and caused tests to be stopped early.
Home notification and adoption redesign changes failed to deliver clear positive results across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (such as adoption copy, adoption incentive, adoption new flow, choose path new screen, and home redesign) still have thin evidence.
